title: AI × Math 每日精选
subtitle: 自动推理、形式化证明、数学智能与基础模型。
method: 公开来源采集、历史去重、规则筛选与模型审阅
method_note: 系统保存当日公开元数据，与历史日报核验后排除已报道事件；论文新版本、新修订及不同软件发布等可核实更新仍可入选，随后由指定模型阅读全文摘要并完成精选。

items.title: Lost in Reordering: Structural Sensitivity of Multilingual LLMs under Semantics-Preserving Perturbations
items.abstract_or_text: Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate strong multilingual reasoning performance, yet their robustness to semantics-preserving structural variation remains underexplored, particularly for relatively free word-order languages. We investigate the structural sensitivity of multilingual LLMs using two linguistically grounded perturbation settings in Hindi and Malayalam: constrained constituent reordering and active-passive voice transformation. We introduce a benchmark dataset IndicReStruct, with two variants, GSM8K-Reordered and GSM8K-Voice, constructed from GSM8K while preserving semantic meaning. Across six state-of-the-art LLMs and multiple prompting strategies, we observe consistent and significant degradation in mathematical reasoning performance under structurally perturbed inputs. To further understand these failures, we perform qualitative error analysis and mechanistic interpretability experiments using residual-stream activation patching. Our analyses show that reasoning failures frequently arise from disruptions in entity-quantity alignment and that intermediate transformer layers contribute most strongly toward reasoning restoration. Overall, our findings suggest that current multilingual LLMs remain highly sensitive to surface syntactic realization and lack robust compositional invariance under structurally different but semantically equivalent inputs.
items.summary_zh: 该研究以 Hindi 和 Malayalam 中保持语义不变的语序重排、主被动转换为扰动，构建 IndicReStruct，并在 GSM8K 衍生任务上检验六个 LLM 的数学推理稳健性。结果显示，结构变化会稳定降低表现，残差流激活修补分析将部分失败关联到实体与数量的对应关系。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它将“数学题做对”与“对等价表述保持稳定”区分开来，为多语言数学推理的稳健性评测提供了具体检验设置。
items.abstract_zh: Large Language Models (LLMs) 展现出较强的多语言推理表现，但其对于保持语义不变的结构变化的稳健性仍缺乏研究，尤其是在语序相对自由的语言中。我们在 Hindi 和 Malayalam 中使用两种具有语言学依据的扰动设置研究多语言 LLM 的结构敏感性：受约束的成分重排与主动—被动语态转换。我们引入基准数据集 IndicReStruct，它包含两个变体 GSM8K-Reordered 和 GSM8K-Voice，均由 GSM8K 构建，同时保持语义不变。在六个最先进 LLM 和多种提示策略上，我们观察到，结构扰动输入会一致且显著地降低数学推理表现。为进一步理解这些失败，我们进行了定性错误分析，并使用残差流激活修补开展机制可解释性实验。分析显示，推理失败常源于实体—数量对齐受到破坏，中间 Transformer 层对恢复推理的贡献最强。总体而言，我们的发现表明，当前多语言 LLM 对表层句法实现仍高度敏感，在结构不同但语义等价的输入下缺乏稳健的组合不变性。
items.author_line: Karthika Nhayakkat, Rajat Verma, Maharaj Brahma, Vetcha Gnana Mahesh, Maunendra Sankar Desarkar, Ganesh Ramakrishnan, Rohit Saluja

items.title: Gradients Know What Outcomes Don't: Unlocking Reinforcement Learning for LLM Reasoning with Gradient-Aligned Rewards
items.abstract_or_text: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) drives chain-of-thought reasoning in large language models, yet its binary outcome reward cannot distinguish among correct trajectories. Existing dense reward alternatives, from surface heuristics to process reward models, either ignore the expert solutions already present in training corpora or require expensive offline annotation. We propose Gradient-Aligned Reward (GAR), which operates in the policy's own gradient space: truncated backpropagation through the output projection layer extracts a compact gradient vector for each rollout, and cosine similarity with an expert-anchor gradient yields a dense, reasoning-aware reward with less than 9% wall-clock overhead. We prove that this cosine admits a multiplicative decomposition into prediction-error and activation-pattern factors, providing a concrete characterization of what the alignment signal measures. On Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B, GAR consistently improves over GRPO and other baselines on competition-level math benchmarks and transfers to GPQA Diamond and MMLU-Pro without domain-specific data. Code and data are available at https://github.com/LQgdwind/GAR.
items.summary_zh: GAR 在策略梯度空间中，把每条 rollout 的紧凑梯度向量与专家锚点梯度作余弦比较，形成稠密奖励。论文在 Qwen3-4B 与 Qwen3-8B 上报告其在竞赛级数学基准优于 GRPO 等比较方法，并测试了向 GPQA Diamond、MMLU-Pro 的迁移。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该方法把可验证结果奖励扩展为可分析的梯度对齐信号；其数学基准和跨领域测试为奖励设计是否改善推理提供了可复查的实验主张。
items.abstract_zh: 来自可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）推动了大语言模型中的思维链推理，但其二元结果奖励无法区分不同的正确轨迹。现有的稠密奖励替代方案，从表层启发式方法到过程奖励模型，要么忽略训练语料中已有的专家解答，要么需要昂贵的离线标注。我们提出 Gradient-Aligned Reward（GAR），它在策略自身的梯度空间中工作：通过输出投影层的截断反向传播，为每条 rollout 提取紧凑的梯度向量；再计算其与专家锚点梯度的余弦相似度，得到一种具有推理感知能力的稠密奖励，额外墙钟时间开销低于 9%。我们证明，该余弦相似度可乘法分解为预测误差因子和激活模式因子，从而具体刻画这一对齐信号所度量的内容。在 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-8B 上，GAR 在竞赛级数学基准上持续优于 GRPO 和其他基线，并且无需领域专用数据即可迁移到 GPQA Diamond 和 MMLU-Pro。代码和数据可见于 https://github.com/LQgdwind/GAR。
items.author_line: Leqi Zheng, Jinbo Su, Fang Niu, Chaokun Wang, Weiping Wang, Jiajun Zhang, Shannan Yan, Jie Wu, Zhaolu Kang, Rong Fu, Hang Zhang

items.title: Extending concurrent separation logic to the hardware level to verify the xv6 OS kernel on RISC-V with AI agents
items.abstract_or_text: MachCSL is a framework for verifying systems software, such as an OS kernel, on top of low-level semantics of a RISC-V computer, based on the Sail RISC-V semantics. The key idea behind MachCSL is to adapt concurrent separation logic, based on Iris, to reasoning about low-level hardware execution at the sub-instruction level: page-table translation, TLB, privilege levels, configuration registers, instruction fetch/decode/execute, traps and interrupts, DMA, shared memory, power failures, etc. Reasoning at this level of detail ensures that the system software correctly manages all of the hardware details. Verifying software at this low level of abstraction is tedious, but LLM-based agents are capable of reasoning about such low-level details. As a case study, we verify the xv6 OS kernel (6,593 lines of C and assembly code), which provides a traditional Unix system call interface (processes, file system, file descriptors, and preemptive scheduling) and has substantial internal concurrency (multi-core support with fine-grained locking, shared memory, interrupts, DMA, etc.). In the verification process, we uncovered nine bugs in the xv6 implementation, as well as one bug in the Sail RISC-V semantics. The verification effort took us 77 days, including the time to develop the MachCSL framework.
items.summary_zh: MachCSL 将基于 Iris 的并发分离逻辑延伸到 Sail RISC-V 语义下的指令级硬件执行，并以 AI agents 协助验证 6,593 行 C 与汇编构成的 xv6 内核。摘要报告发现了 xv6 的 9 个缺陷及 Sail RISC-V 语义中的 1 个缺陷。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作把操作系统验证同时关联到页表、TLB、特权级、中断和 DMA 等硬件细节，说明 AI agents 可参与规模较大的形式化验证工作；其结论仍应结合公开证明工件进一步核验。
items.abstract_zh: MachCSL 是一个用于验证系统软件的框架，例如操作系统内核；它建立在 RISC-V 计算机的低层语义之上，并以 Sail RISC-V 语义为基础。MachCSL 的核心思想是将基于 Iris 的并发分离逻辑改造为可对指令子级别的低层硬件执行进行推理：页表转换、TLB、特权级、配置寄存器、指令取指／解码／执行、陷阱和中断、DMA、共享内存、断电等。在这一细节层次上推理，可确保系统软件正确管理所有硬件细节。在如此低的抽象层次验证软件很繁琐，但基于 LLM 的 agents 能够对这些低层细节进行推理。作为案例研究，我们验证了 xv6 操作系统内核（6,593 行 C 和汇编代码），它提供传统 Unix 系统调用接口（进程、文件系统、文件描述符和抢占式调度），并具有大量内部并发性（带细粒度锁的多核支持、共享内存、中断、DMA 等）。在验证过程中，我们发现了 xv6 实现中的九个错误，以及 Sail RISC-V 语义中的一个错误。验证工作耗时 77 天，其中包括开发 MachCSL 框架的时间。

items.title: NeuroSTAR: Automata-guided Neuro-symbolic Specification Formalization
items.abstract_or_text: Automated translation of natural language (NL) descriptions into Linear Temporal Logic over finite traces (LTLf) is a prerequisite for automated formal verification of a system's dynamic behavior. Several LLM-based methods have recently shown potential for this task. However, they struggle with the nuance of natural language descriptions, which can lead LLMs to only partially capture the intended meaning. To address this limitation, we propose NeuroSTAR (Automata-guided Neuro-symbolic Specification Formalization), an NL-to-LTLf framework that builds on two insights. First, it leverages multiple generators to obtain diverse LTLf candidates. Second, it uses an automata-theoretic semantic comparison based on DFA traces to identify behavioral disagreements that guide formula refinement. We evaluate NeuroSTAR and show that it improves NL-to-LTLf translation performance by 8-18 percentage points relative to the prior state-of-the-art (SoTA) on unambiguous benchmarks. We further study its applicability to a body of driving law text, a complex, realistic, and reference-free domain critical for autonomous-vehicle specification. This study shows that NeuroSTAR can capture the necessary temporal semantics in 83.9% of the driving law sections, which demonstrates the effectiveness of automata-guided reference-free refinement in formalization.
items.summary_zh: NeuroSTAR 将自然语言转写为有限轨迹线性时序逻辑（LTLf），以多生成器产生候选公式，并用 DFA 轨迹比较发现行为分歧、指导修订。论文报告在无歧义基准上较此前最好方法提高 8–18 个百分点，并在驾驶法规文本中得到 83.9% 的时序语义捕获率。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 自然语言规格是否被正确形式化直接影响后续验证的可信度；自动机语义比较提供了比仅凭文本相似度更可检验的修订依据。
items.abstract_zh: 将自然语言（NL）描述自动翻译为有限轨迹上的线性时序逻辑（LTLf），是系统动态行为自动形式化验证的前提。近来，若干基于 LLM 的方法已显示出完成这一任务的潜力。然而，它们难以处理自然语言描述中的细微含义，可能导致 LLM 只捕捉到预期含义的一部分。为解决这一局限，我们提出 NeuroSTAR（Automata-guided Neuro-symbolic Specification Formalization），一个 NL-to-LTLf 框架，其建立在两点认识之上。第一，它利用多个生成器获得多样化的 LTLf 候选项。第二，它采用基于 DFA 轨迹的自动机理论语义比较来识别行为分歧，并据此引导公式修订。我们评估了 NeuroSTAR，结果表明，在无歧义基准上，它相对于此前最先进方法将 NL-to-LTLf 翻译性能提高了 8–18 个百分点。我们还研究了它对一组驾驶法规文本的适用性，这是一个复杂、真实且缺少参考答案、但对自动驾驶规格至关重要的领域。该研究显示，NeuroSTAR 能够捕捉 83.9% 驾驶法规段落所需的时序语义，表明自动机引导的无参考答案修订在形式化中的有效性。
items.author_line: Joy Saha, Trey Woodlief, Sebastian Elbaum, Matthew B. Dwyer

items.title: CORE: Improving Compositional Reasoning in MLLM Embedding via Reranker Distillation
items.abstract_or_text: MLLM-based embedding models remain limited in compositional retrieval, often failing to distinguish scenes containing the same concepts but different attribute-object bindings. Yet the same backbone can resolve such distinctions when used as a cross-attentive reranker, motivating us to distill its compositional judgments into the embedding model. We propose CORE, which synthesizes candidate lists spanning five compositional matching levels and introduces a Rank-KL objective that trains the embedding model to reproduce the reranker's fine-grained ranking. We further introduce a graded evaluation protocol and compare contrastive learning, pairwise CoSENT, and listwise Rank-KL under the same data and tuning budget. Our comparison shows that both CoSENT and Rank-KL use the multi-level supervision more effectively than contrastive learning, with Rank-KL achieving the strongest overall performance. Across three compositional reasoning benchmarks (COLA, SUGARCREPE++, NEGBENCH), CORE-RERANKER-8B achieves an 82.7% total average, outperforming Jina-Reranker by 10.7 points, while CORE-EMBED-8B achieves the best total average (0.666) among all evaluated embedding models. The improvements transfer to the MCMR benchmark without sacrificing retrieval performance on COCO and Flickr30K.
items.summary_zh: CORE 通过让嵌入模型蒸馏交叉注意力重排序器的组合判断，改善视觉—语言检索中属性与对象绑定的区分。作者在 COLA、SUGARCREPE++、NEGBENCH 上比较多种训练目标，并报告 CORE-RERANKER-8B 的总平均分为 82.7%，CORE-EMBED-8B 在所评估嵌入模型中总平均分最高。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 组合关系的辨析是多模态推理中的基础能力。该研究提供了统一数据和调参预算下的训练目标比较，也同时检查了组合基准提升与通用检索表现。
items.abstract_zh: 基于 MLLM 的嵌入模型在组合检索方面仍受限制，常常无法区分包含相同概念、但属性—对象绑定不同的场景。然而，当同一骨干网络用作带交叉注意力的重排序器时，它能够解决这类区分，这促使我们将其组合判断蒸馏到嵌入模型中。我们提出 CORE，它合成覆盖五个组合匹配层级的候选列表，并引入 Rank-KL 目标，以训练嵌入模型复现重排序器细粒度的排序。我们还引入分级评估协议，并在相同数据和微调预算下比较对比学习、成对 CoSENT 和列表式 Rank-KL。比较结果显示，CoSENT 和 Rank-KL 都比对比学习更有效地利用多层级监督，其中 Rank-KL 取得最强的总体性能。在三个组合推理基准（COLA、SUGARCREPE++、NEGBENCH）上，CORE-RERANKER-8B 的总平均分达到 82.7%，比 Jina-Reranker 高 10.7 分；CORE-EMBED-8B 在所有评估的嵌入模型中取得最佳总平均分（0.666）。这些改进可迁移到 MCMR 基准，同时不牺牲 COCO 和 Flickr30K 上的检索性能。
items.author_line: Tingyu Song, Mingxin Li, Yanzhao Zhang, Dingkun Long, Chu Liu, Pengjun Xie, Yilun Zhao, Shu Wu

items.title: The Geometry of Ignorance: LLMs Know When to Temper Bayesian Priors
items.abstract_or_text: What does a language model predict when it has few clues? The answer lurks in its unembedding geometry: a single direction of the unembedding matrix encodes the unigram distribution of the training corpus, which serves as the Bayesian prior the model falls back on when uncertain. This structure --- which we term the direction of ignorance --- appears in all four model families examined (Llama, Qwen, Gemma, and Pythia), ranging from 0.4B to 405B parameters. Projecting the final prediction state onto this direction yields a per-token prior loading factor λ, which, empirically, declines steadily as the context becomes more informative. Formally, the same projection decomposes the prediction state into two orthogonal vectors that correspond exactly to the two factors of a tempered Bayesian update: a unigram prior raised to the exponent λ and a context-driven likelihood. This geometric-probabilistic interpretation calibrates λ, making it meaningfully comparable across model sizes and families, with larger models generally exhibiting lower prior reliance in the high-context limit. Finally, we show that the direction of ignorance is causally active: raising or lowering λ at the final prediction state steers the prediction toward or away from the unigram prior in KL divergence.
items.summary_zh: 论文提出“无知方向”，将语言模型在信息不足时的 unigram 回退解释为可测量的 Bayesian prior 载荷，并在 Llama、Qwen、Gemma、Pythia 四个模型家族中考察这一几何结构。作者还报告，直接调节该载荷会使预测在 KL divergence 意义下趋向或远离 unigram prior。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把模型不确定时的预测行为转化为一个明确的几何—概率假说，并给出跨模型观察与因果干预测试；这有助于区分模型对上下文证据的利用和对训练分布先验的依赖。
items.abstract_zh: 当线索很少时，语言模型会预测什么？答案隐藏在它的 unembedding 几何中：unembedding 矩阵的单一方向编码了训练语料的 unigram 分布，它充当模型在不确定时回退到的 Bayesian prior。我们将这一结构称为无知方向；在所考察的全部四个模型家族（Llama、Qwen、Gemma 和 Pythia）中均可观察到它，模型规模从 0.4B 到 405B 不等。将最终预测状态投影到这一方向上，会得到逐 token 的先验载荷因子 λ；从经验上看，随着上下文信息变得更充分，该因子持续下降。在形式上，同一投影将预测状态分解为两个正交向量，它们恰好对应于温和化 Bayesian 更新的两个因子：以 λ 为指数的 unigram prior，以及由上下文驱动的 likelihood。这一几何—概率解释校准了 λ，使其可在不同模型规模和家族之间进行有意义的比较；在高上下文极限下，更大的模型通常表现出更低的先验依赖。最后，我们表明无知方向具有因果作用：在最终预测状态上提高或降低 λ，会使预测在 KL divergence 意义下趋向或远离 unigram prior。
items.author_line: Toni J. B. Liu, Jiajun Bao, Yizhou Liu, Gurbir Arora, Nicolas Boullé, Raphaël Sarfati, Christopher J. Earls

items.title: It's the Problem, Not the Path: Budget and Difficulty Confounds in LLM Reasoning Trajectories
items.abstract_or_text: Reasoning traces of large language models are widely read as containing "breakthrough" moments and early-legible fates. Both readings rest on measurements missing a counterfactual control at the level of the claim; we supply both controls. First, a restart-controlled truncation probe separates when a solution fits the continuation budget from when a prefix carries value that fresh computation cannot buy, comparing per-anchor continuation solve rates against from-scratch restart curves at matched total generated-token budget. Applied to 178 problem-model cells (89 MATH problems x two small open models, an outcome-blind but difficulty-targeted cohort), exactly 1 of 178 cells survives as prefix-limited; restart dose-response separates a compute-starved model from a capability-limited one; and wherever the matched budget lies inside the restart grid, continuing the model's own prefix beats restarting (9 of 9) -- predominantly compute compression rather than expanded reachability. Second, a pre-registered, difficulty-controlled test finds no detectable outcome information in early-window internal signals beyond a problem-difficulty baseline, and two generation-free analyses of public corpora show why this control is needed: a trace-blind difficulty proxy reaches AUROC 0.873 on 192K DeepSeek-R1 generations -- inside the published probe range -- and a closely matched reconstruction of the closest published early-window positive recovers a comparable pooled result (0.849) while within problem it is statistically indistinguishable from chance at all ten anchors (0.496 at t=4); a post-hoc within-targeted probe finds only a small average residual, concentrated in three low-failure problems. High pooled probe AUROCs cannot by themselves establish within-attempt information; a question-only baseline or within-problem evaluation is required.
items.summary_zh: 该研究以重启对照和难度控制审视 LLM 推理轨迹中的“突破时刻”及早期成功预测。在 89 道 MATH 题、两个小型开放模型构成的 178 个问题—模型单元中，作者报告仅 1 个单元显示前缀本身受限；同时指出高汇总 AUROC 可主要由题目难度混杂造成。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它为推理轨迹分析补入计算预算和题目难度对照，提醒研究者不能以跨题汇总指标直接推断单次尝试中存在可读出的成功信号。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型的推理轨迹常被解读为包含“突破”时刻和可较早辨识的结局。这两种解读都依赖于在相应主张层面缺少反事实控制的测量；我们为二者都提供了控制。第一种是受重启控制的截断探针，它区分解答何时只是符合续写预算，以及前缀何时携带了重新计算无法获得的价值；它在总生成 token 预算匹配的条件下，将每个锚点的续写求解率与从头重启曲线相比较。应用于 178 个问题—模型单元（89 道 MATH 问题乘以两个小型开放模型；一个对结果盲、但以难度为目标的队列）时，178 个单元中恰有 1 个保留下来可被视为前缀受限；重启剂量—反应关系区分了计算不足的模型与能力受限的模型；并且只要匹配预算位于重启网格内，续写模型自身前缀就优于重启（9 次比较中均如此），这主要体现为计算压缩，而非可达解空间的扩大。第二种预注册、难度受控的检验发现，早期窗口内部信号没有超出题目难度基线的可检测结果信息；对公开语料进行的两项无需生成的分析说明了为何这一控制必不可少：一个不看轨迹的难度代理指标在 192K 条 DeepSeek-R1 生成结果上达到 AUROC 0.873，处在已发表探针的范围内；对最接近的已发表早期窗口正面结果进行高度匹配的重建，得到可比的汇总结果 0.849，但在每道题内部，它在全部十个锚点上都与随机机会无统计学差异（t=4 时为 0.496）；一项事后在目标集合内进行的探针仅发现很小的平均残余，集中在三道低失败率问题上。高的汇总探针 AUROC 本身不能证明单次尝试内部存在信息；需要使用仅含问题的基线，或在问题内部进行评估。

review.note: 保留 7 项质量分不低于 70 的候选。入选项均为候选文件标注的公开 preprint；未见 OpenReview 投稿或撤回状态。筛选优先考虑了可定义的推理或形式化任务、明确的评测设置及可核查的结果陈述。
